headline: KBRA Reports Record Quarterly Jump in Private Credit Defaults
summary: A record 112 private debt borrowers defaulted on their obligations during the quarter, marking a 22% increase from the previous period according to KBRA.
why: Private credit has expanded rapidly as an alternative funding source for companies, making default trends an important indicator of corporate financial health.

impacts.name: Private Credit
impacts.why: An increase in defaults directly reflects higher credit stress within the private debt sector.
